# SportsClub Project Instructions

This project uses:

- React
- TypeScript
- Vite
- Tailwind CSS
- React Router

Design Guidelines:

- Blue, white and green theme
- Glassmorphism UI
- Rounded cards
- Premium sports club appearance
- Responsive design
- Reusable components
- Maintain consistency with existing landing page
- Never replace existing pages unless requested
- Create modular components
- Use React Router for navigation
